text: The lunch in the fridge. My bag. My name on it. In Sharpie. Two times.
There's barbecue sauce on your eyebrow.
Meal prep? That's my mama's chicken. She cut the crust off my sandwich, because I asked her to. And your sandwich? No crust.
Mid?! So you ate it, and then you gave it a review?
Hold up. Where did that forty dollars come from?
So you used my own money, to pay me back?
